_instructions: Edit this file to update the site — no HTML/CSS needed. 'spotifyEmbedUrl' is the iframe URL for the Listen section, e.g. https://open.spotify.com/embed/artist/<ID>?utm_source=generator&theme=0 (leave empty for a placeholder). Each act needs a name; role and description are optional. Each link needs a url; 'platform' picks the icon (spotify, apple, youtube, bandcamp, soundcloud — anything else falls back to a generic link icon) and 'label' is the button text. Add as many acts or links as you want, in any order — the site just reads this list.

acts.name: We All Perish
acts.role: Writing, performance & production — varies by era
acts.description: Born from the vibrant musical tapestry of Southern Louisiana, We All Perish merges a diverse array of rock influences, weaving together Indie, Pop, 90s Grunge, Emo, Punk, Ska, Metalcore, Nu Metal, Post Hardcore, Djent, and Alt Rock backgrounds. The dynamic ensemble comprises Sammy Vincent (vocals), Salem Riddle (guitar/vocals), Deion Lanthier (guitars/vocals), Coory Joshlin (bass), and Shane Landry (drums). Renowned for their electrifying live performances, each member brings a wealth of experience from previous musical endeavors, and infused with boundless energy and audience-engaging singalongs, their reputation precedes them. These South Louisiana talents have shared stages with notable national acts, including Puddle Of Mudd, Saliva, 12 Stones, Gemini Syndrome, Saving Abel, Papa Roach, Starset, Pop Evil, Filter, and Buckcherry.
